subject: SWZ
name: Eswatini
note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. IDs are TL:<subject>:<measure>:<vintage> and stable across builds: a changed value under the same ID is an upstream revision (recorded in the ledger at /ledger); a new observed year is a new claim. A null or absent figure mints no claim — absence is never zero. Scheme: https://terralore.co/integrity

claims.title: Nguni peoples move south
claims.summary: Bantu-speaking Nguni groups, among them the ancestors of the Dlamini, migrate southward into south-eastern Africa over the following centuries.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1500-nguni-peoples-move-south, claim TL:SWZ:event:1500:nguni-peoples-move-south, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reign of Ngwane III
claims.summary: Ngwane III, traditionally regarded as the first king of the modern Swazi, leads his followers across the Pongola and is remembered for founding the kingdom, with a capital at Shiselweni.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1745-reign-of-ngwane-iii, claim TL:SWZ:event:1745:reign-of-ngwane-iii, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Accession of Sobhuza I
claims.summary: On the death of Ndvungunye, Somhlolo becomes king as Sobhuza I and soon faces the pressures of the mfecane and the Ndwandwe under Zwide.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1815-accession-of-sobhuza-i, claim TL:SWZ:event:1815:accession-of-sobhuza-i, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Migration into central Eswatini
claims.summary: Attacked by the Ndwandwe, Sobhuza I moves his people north and establishes a kingdom centred on the Ezulwini valley, the heartland of the Swazi nation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1820-migration-into-central-eswatini, claim TL:SWZ:event:1820:migration-into-central-eswatini, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reign of Mswati II begins
claims.summary: Mswati II succeeds Sobhuza I; he reorganises the army into age-regiments and expands the kingdom to its greatest extent. The Swazi take their name from him.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1840-reign-of-mswati-ii-begins, claim TL:SWZ:event:1840:reign-of-mswati-ii-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Death of Mswati II
claims.summary: The death of Mswati II ends the era of Swazi conquest and expansion, leaving a unified nation at its widest territorial reach.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1868-death-of-mswati-ii, claim TL:SWZ:event:1868:death-of-mswati-ii, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mbandzeni becomes king
claims.summary: Mbandzeni (Dlamini IV) ascends the throne; his reign coincides with an influx of European concession-seekers into the kingdom.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1875-mbandzeni-becomes-king, claim TL:SWZ:event:1875:mbandzeni-becomes-king, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The concessions era
claims.summary: Mbandzeni grants extensive land, grazing and mineral concessions to Boer and British fortune-seekers, ceding control over most of the kingdom's land and resources.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1880-the-concessions-era, claim TL:SWZ:event:1880:the-concessions-era, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Protectorate of the South African Republic
claims.summary: By convention the Transvaal (South African Republic) takes over the administration of Swaziland as a protectorate, while the kingdom keeps nominal autonomy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1894-protectorate-of-the-south-african-republic, claim TL:SWZ:event:1894:protectorate-of-the-south-african-republic, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: A High Commission Territory
claims.summary: After the Second Boer War, control of Swaziland passes from the Transvaal governor to the High Commissioner for South Africa, making it a High Commission Territory under direct British oversight.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1906-a-high-commission-territory, claim TL:SWZ:event:1906:a-high-commission-territory, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kept out of the Union of South Africa
claims.summary: When the Union of South Africa is formed, Swaziland remains under direct British control; despite later South African requests, the territory is never transferred.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1910-kept-out-of-the-union-of-south-africa, claim TL:SWZ:event:1910:kept-out-of-the-union-of-south-africa, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sobhuza II becomes Ngwenyama
claims.summary: Sobhuza II assumes the kingship and makes the recovery of Swazi land lost in the concessions a defining cause of his long reign.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1921-sobhuza-ii-becomes-ngwenyama, claim TL:SWZ:event:1921:sobhuza-ii-becomes-ngwenyama, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Self-government and elections
claims.summary: Under a revised constitution Swaziland gains internal self-government; the king's Imbokodvo National Movement wins the elections, setting the stage for independence.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1967-self-government-and-elections, claim TL:SWZ:event:1967:self-government-and-elections, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence of Swaziland
claims.summary: Swaziland becomes an independent kingdom, free of British rule, with Sobhuza II as head of state under a Westminster-style constitution.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1968-independence-of-swaziland, claim TL:SWZ:event:1968:independence-of-swaziland, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sobhuza II repeals the constitution
claims.summary: King Sobhuza II repeals the independence constitution, dissolves parliament and bans political parties, ruling thereafter by decree as an absolute monarch.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1973-sobhuza-ii-repeals-the-constitution, claim TL:SWZ:event:1973:sobhuza-ii-repeals-the-constitution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Death of Sobhuza II
claims.summary: Sobhuza II dies after a reign of some sixty years, among the longest in recorded history, leaving the throne to a regency.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1982-death-of-sobhuza-ii, claim TL:SWZ:event:1982:death-of-sobhuza-ii, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Coronation of Mswati III
claims.summary: Aged eighteen, Mswati III is crowned king, continuing the absolute monarchy with his mother Ntfombi as Ndlovukati.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Eswatini: The kingdom of the Lion and the She-Elephant, Africa's last absolute monarchy", terralore.co/country/SWZ/chronicle#ev-1986-coronation-of-mswati-iii, claim TL:SWZ:event:1986:coronation-of-mswati-iii, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Swaziland becomes Eswatini
claims.summary: On the fiftieth anniversary of independence, Mswati III renames the country the Kingdom of Eswatini, reviving its siSwati name.

claims.title: Pro-democracy protests
claims.summary: Pro-democracy protests sweep Eswatini and are met by a deadly crackdown, the most serious challenge yet to one of the world's last absolute monarchies.

sources.label: Pro-democracy protests in Eswatini
sources.publisher: UK Parliament, House of Commons Library

sources.label: Africa's last absolute monarchy is shaken as protestors defy Eswatini's king
